data.name: Neveen
data.gender_notes: Neveen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Nafanah’ which means to be graceful, elegant and beautiful. In the Quran, Allah says, ‘And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds’ (21:107). Neveen embodies the qualities of being a source of mercy, kindness, and beauty to all. The name Neveen carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Neveen usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A source of Allah's mercy and beauty
data.etymology: Neveen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neveen total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: نيفين
in_arabic.meaning: نيفين تعني الجديد أو الطازج في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نيفين مشتق من الجذر العربي ن-ي-ف الذي يدل على الجديد أو الطازج. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات العربية للإشارة إلى شخص أو شيء جديد أو منعش. وقد ورد في بعض المصادر اللغوية العربية أن النيفين هو نوع من أنواع الزهور التي تتميز برائحتها الجميلة ونضارتها.

in_english.name: Neveen
in_english.meaning: Neveen means new or fresh in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Neveen originates from the Arabic root ن-ی-ف (n-y-f), which signifies new or fresh. This name is used across various Muslim cultures to denote something or someone new, hopeful, or rejuvenated. Etymologically, it relates to concepts of renewal and revitalization. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to express positive attributes such as novelty and purity. In Islamic tradition, names are chosen for their meanings and spiritual significance, and Neveen reflects these values.
